problem.telemarketing: non-human entities pretending to be human
problem.goal: eat all spam, telemarketers, and non-human contacts from here on

layer_1_ios_native.action: Settings → Phone → Silence Unknown Callers → ON
layer_1_ios_native.effect: All calls from numbers NOT in contacts go straight to voicemail
layer_1_ios_native.note: This is the nuclear option — instant 99% spam kill

layer_2_carrier.att_activearmor: Enable AT&T ActiveArmor app (free tier blocks fraud)
layer_2_carrier.mint_spam_shield: If on Mint, enable spam ID in account settings
layer_2_carrier.note: Carrier-level blocking happens before the call even reaches the phone

layer_3_block_list.method: Analyze call history, extract spam numbers, bulk block
layer_3_block_list.ios_api: Can push blocking via MDM profile or automation
regex_patterns: Any number calling 3+ times with no pickup = spam
Any number not in contacts calling during business hours = likely spam

layer_4_gaia_thymus.method: Gaia's immune system tracks call patterns on the LAN
layer_4_gaia_thymus.southgate_role: Home phone filters — only known numbers ring through
layer_4_gaia_thymus.ecoprimal_role: Personal phone — silence unknown + carrier blocking
layer_4_gaia_thymus.learning: Over time, the organism learns which numbers are human

layer_5_future.esim_sovereign: When we own the telecom path, we control routing
layer_5_future.voip_gateway: Route through Gaia's own SIP/VoIP — full call control
layer_5_future.ai_screening: Local ollama screens voicemail transcripts for humanity
layer_5_future.endgame: Only verified humans get through. Everything else = null.

immediate_actions: 1. Turn ON Silence Unknown Callers (iOS Settings → Phone)
3. Register number on Do Not Call Registry (donotcall.gov)
